pr_title: docs: improve the doc about Raw operator and add missing test
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/issues/6860
(see the discussion there)

# What

- Improves the doc after the recent merge of https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/6850 

> (feat: add ability for escaping for Raw() find operator)

- add a missing test

# Test plan

- no code change
- waiting for CI to let new test pass
- I didn't test my changes on website as I don't know how to run the site locally: let me know if that is needed

# Note 

- I'm not a native English speaker so feel free to comment to improve the wordings, if needed, and I will update the PR.
- maybe we shall merge this once (or just before) the code is deployed on npm.
pr_comments: @temnov98 : you may want to review this.

@pleerock Out of curiosity, where does the `:...data` syntax come from ? Is it typeorm magie, or rather pg-node standard.
I found https://github.com/brianc/node-postgres/issues/1490 but I didn'tthink the discussion ended in this solution.

> * I didn't test my changes on website as I don't know how to run the site locally: let me know if that is needed

It would be nice. You can test on at least some databases. It's not that hard - you can run databases in docker.

>  Out of curiosity, where does the :...data syntax come from ?

It is typeorm magic. Not a great implementation however, but it just works.

> It would be nice. You can test on at least some databases. It's not that hard - you can run databases in docker.

@temnov98: My sentence wasn't clear

My changes are double:
- part 1) I added documentation
- part 2) I added one test.

So:
- ✅ For 2), the CI seems to run all the tests on different env: that seems enough. If tests pass, we are ok, if not there is an issue.
- ⚠️ For 1), I tried my best to write markdown, but I didn't actually test that the website is well-formated after the local changes, as I don't know how to run the website locally. It will prevent for instance non matching ` ```<code>`` `

If I need to test the website locally, I expect some contributor steps like:
- clone `https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm.github.io`
- inside a subdir, clone ``https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm`
- run `yarn start`

> * For 1), I tried my best to write markdown, but I didn't actually test that the website is well-formated after the local changes, as I don't know how to run the website locally.

Oh. I'm not a native English speaker either. Try click on this button for display the rich diff. Did you mean it?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22731353/95252729-0aecc280-0826-11eb-9271-f5982baf77e6.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22731353/95253239-c877b580-0826-11eb-8158-b3bde8a4f0b0.png)

> Try click on this button for display the rich diff. Did you mean it?

Makes sense.
So I guess it is ready for review.

Thank you @imnotjames.

I think we should also deploy an npm version else the doc will document an unreleased version, as I mentioned in the PR description.
